macroquadStabilization.goal: Prevent normal editor actions from forcing a Macroquad font-atlas texture resize/recreation in the middle of a batched visible frame.

runtimeRules: All editor text must route through draw_editor_text / measure_editor_text.
Pixel-art texture filtering must not change the Segoe font atlas filter.
New dialogs/documents/workspaces must reuse the fixed raster tiers instead of introducing arbitrary glyph raster sizes.

If future Unicode coverage is expanded substantially, extend startup prewarm or migrate the editor text adapter to a dedicated static/shaped text backend rather than reintroducing unbounded Macroquad atlas churn.
